name: stonehaven_block
notes: Opponent attacks next turn for exactly our 4 HP; no defender, IKZ 0. Portal AZK01-045 with Stonehaven, grant it Defender (base HP <= gate power), then block an attack to survive.

name: declare_defender
notes: Stonehaven Defender already granted; opponent declared its first attack and total incoming damage equals our HP. Declare the defender to survive.

name: stonehaven_unneeded
notes: Same structure but incoming damage is one less than our HP: survival needs nothing (control; portal/defender optional).

name: quicksand_lethal
notes: One ready attacker (AZK01-045) with exact lethal, but the opponent has an untapped Foamback Crab defender and blocks. Quicksand (5 IKZ, all 5 open) clears every <=2-HP entity first. Bobu's 1-IKZ ability first makes Quicksand uncastable (harmful).

name: goro_trade
notes: Tapped enemy AZK01-058 would trade evenly with our STT02-004 (its attack equals our health). Goro (1 IKZ) gives +1 health first, so the attack removes it and our attacker survives.
